verdict.rationale: YubiKey stores secrets on the device's secure element, and Yubico also runs a cloud service (YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' console and API), so a residency question is fair for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region or data residency for any Yubico-hosted data. On-device key storage is a different capability from selecting a hosting region and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
